summary: Duplicate pending tags on chunks reviewed by two different model batches
description: Found during the round-2 quarantine wave-3 review (2026-08-06): sta.097 and sta.304 each carry two sets of pending staged_tags from separate model batches on the same chunk, i.e. duplicate proposals rather than a single reviewable set. Only these two are confirmed; the underlying cause (whatever produced two batches on the same chunk) likely recurs elsewhere in the corpus and hasn't been scanned for. Needs: (1) a query for chunks with >1 batch of pending staged_tags on the same concept, (2) a decision on which batch wins / whether to merge, (3) a dedup pass, similar in spirit to the existing cleanup_dupes.sh precedent used for duplicate chunk bodies.
